name: Forest of the Deer God
source:
A story in which you, a paranormal investigator traveling the country, must find a way to escape after becoming stranded in a forest that defies your understanding.

[From [url=https://dolphinsareevil.itch.io/forest-of-the-deer-god]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个故事中，你是一名周游全国的超自然现象调查员，在被困在你无法理解的森林中后，必须找到逃生的方法。

[来自[url=https://dolphinsareevil.itch.io/forest-of-the-deer-god]Itch.io[/url]]
